name: Pip Underbough
summary: Level 7 halfling Thief rogue — skirmisher, scout, and lock-whisperer with a vicious Sneak Attack.

actions.name: Rapier
actions.description: *Melee Attack Roll:* +7, reach 5 ft. *Hit:* 1d8 + 4 piercing damage. Use the Sneak Attack variant below when the target is distracted.

actions.name: Rapier + Sneak Attack
actions.description: *Melee Attack Roll:* +7, reach 5 ft. *Hit:* 1d8 + 4 piercing plus **4d6 Sneak Attack** — once per turn, when Pip has Advantage or an ally is within 5 ft of the target (and he doesn't have Disadvantage).

actions.name: Shortbow
actions.description: *Ranged Attack Roll:* +7, range 80/320 ft. *Hit:* 1d6 + 4 piercing damage. Add **4d6 Sneak Attack** (roll separately) when it applies.

actions.name: Cunning Action
actions.description: *Bonus Action every turn:* **Dash**, **Disengage**, or **Hide**. As a Thief, Pip may instead use an object or make a Sleight of Hand check (Fast Hands), and climbing costs no extra movement (Second-Story Work).

actions.name: Uncanny Dodge
actions.description: *Reaction, when an attacker he can see hits him:* halve the attack's damage against him.

traits.name: Sneak Attack (4d6)
traits.description: Once per turn, extra 4d6 damage when he hits with a Finesse or ranged weapon and has Advantage, or when another enemy of the target is within 5 ft of it.

traits.name: Evasion
traits.description: On a Dexterity save for half damage: no damage on a success, half on a failure.

traits.name: Expertise
traits.description: Double proficiency on Stealth (+10) and Thieves' Tools (+10); also proficient in Perception, Acrobatics, Sleight of Hand, Investigation.

traits.name: Lucky
traits.description: When he rolls a 1 on an attack roll, ability check, or saving throw, he can reroll and must use the new roll.

traits.name: Brave
traits.description: Advantage on saving throws against the Frightened condition.

traits.name: Halfling Nimbleness
traits.description: He can move through the space of any creature at least one size larger.
